recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中數顆巨大巨核細胞，細胞質豐富粉紅，核高度分葉、摺疊成鹿角狀（staghorn），細胞質內可見嗜中性球穿入（emperiopolesis），背景為富含顆粒球的高細胞性骨髓；這種大型過度分葉巨核細胞是原發性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, deeply folded staghorn-like nuclei with mature chromatin
Megakaryocytes loosely grouped without tight clusters or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei
Background hypercellular marrow with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and several enlarged megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are large to giant with abundant mature eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei, and show emperiopolesis of granulocytes. No dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with the megakaryocyte morphology of essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (JAK2/CALR/MPL).

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF megakaryocytes form dense clusters with hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, often with granulocytic hypercellularity.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying sizes rather than predominantly giant hyperlobulated forms, and elevated hemoglobin.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but of normal size and lobation, without giant staghorn forms.
5q- megakaryocytes are small to medium with non-lobated round nuclei, the opposite of hyperlobulation.
